deploy-bot: :rocket: Staging deploy started for hydra
env=staging  tag=v1.12.4  commit=9f3c2a7
initiated_by=alice.k  build=https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/45871  rollout=3 pods

alice.k: Kicking off smoke tests now. Will run 10 requests against /predict and a few admin routes. Ping if anything looks off.

ben: Noted. I'm watching dashboards — memory on hydra-sidecar is a bit higher than last deploy, keeping an eye.

carla: Confirmed DB migrations included in this tag: v2025-09-18-add-session-index. Ran locally against a snapshot, looks fine.

alice.k: Smoke command I'm running:```./scripts/smoke.sh hydra --count 10 --routes /predict,/health,/metrics```

deploy-bot: Update: 2/3 pods reported Ready. Traffic ramp to 50%.

sam-oncall: Seeing a handful of 502s for /predict around req_id=tx-3f9e. Might be transient as new pods warm KV cache. Can we hold ramp at 50% until warm?

alice.k: Good catch. Holding at 50% and restarting the one pod that failed readiness check.

ben: After restart the pod came back healthy. Memory stabilized. No further 502s in the last 45s.

carla: Smoke results: 10/10 /predict ok, /health ok, /metrics scraped. Latency slightly up (~120ms -> ~160ms) during warm-up but within SLO.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy completed for hydra  tag=v1.12.4  commit=9f3c2a7  status=success  duration=2m35s  notes=https://confluence.redwood/internal/releases/hydra/v1.12.4

alice.k: :white_check_mark: All smoke checks passed. I'll start writing the rollout plan for prod tomorrow AM and pin the release notes.

sam-oncall: Filing a quick follow-up to dig into the transient 502 (small trace in tracing) but not blocking. cc @ben @carla

ben: Sounds good. I'll add a dashboard alert tweak so we catch readiness flaps faster next time.

carla: Thx — adding a note to the release doc about cache warm-up behavior and recommended ramping.

alice.k: Thanks team.
